# FMC Media PC 0.3.16

- Search opens on a start screen before you type: your recent searches (tap one to search again, remove one, or clear history), Jump to buttons for every page, Try a genre (opens Movies or Series → Browse all with that genre), and Surprise me for a random popular title of the type you picked.
- The search box closes with the Esc key shown at its right.

Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Activation, library and watch progress are preserved. Windows x64.
